svg.title: Spindle shaft drawing (example)
svg.text: Spindle shaft VC-HMC-SPN-0101-A – motor spindle HSK-A63, 10 000 rpm (half section above the axis, outside view below)
Material 31CrMoV9 +QT (EN 10085), gas nitrided · all dimensions in mm · twin example profile (x = 0 at the nose)
Spring chamber x = 190 … 300 · drawbar bore x = 75 … 440 · rear bore x = 440 … 480 · 60° protected centre chamfers in both bore ends
2. Datums: A = front seat, B = rear seat,
Spindle shaft – drawing example with GD&T
Values = twin example values · not to scale · 2026-11
Check before release: bearing maker (seat fits, form, shoulders), motor maker (rotor seat), clamping-set maker (HSK, spring chamber), heat treater (NHD).
Open design point: the Ø41 spring chamber cannot be reached by a normal boring bar – see guide 18, chapter 17.2.
